learning_outcomes.text: The aim of this course is to improve students' Turkish vocabulary, grammar, meaning, and writing skills.

syllabus_topics: What is language? The emergence of languages
Language-thought connection, language-culture connection, language-society connection
Sound properties of Turkish words, stress, syllables
Word Groups, A- Noun phrases, B- Adjective phrases C- Abbreviation Groups, Ç- Title Group, D- Prepositional Group
Sentence, A- Sentence Elements, B- Sentence Types
Spelling Rules (Punctuation marks, Capital letters, lowercase letters, compound words?)
